pages.title: About Math World
pages.content:
Welcome to our Math World programme! Math World contains of 336 courses that cover all math learning goals for the primary education grades K to 6.

Each grade has 48 math courses that can be followed randomly, or via our suggested route as shown on the world map. This route is based on the math curriculum.

Math World can either be used on the World-map route, or via the List-view. The List-view provides an overview of all courses on one page so you can easily find the course you’re looking for.
Are you looking for a course in a specific subject? Then it’s best to use our search-option.

An overview of the learning goals per Math World-course can be found in the following PDF-file.

pages.title: Parents & teachers
pages.content:
Math World is developed by e-leaning for kids, a non-profit organization. Our vision is to be the source for childhood learning on the internet available from anywhere and without charge. E-Learning for kids integrates gaming and learning to make our courseware more effective.

You are currently in our Math World portal: a learning journey in which children acquire new math-skills while learning more about the continents, countries, and cultures around the world.

Math World is for grade K-6, or for ages 5-12, and is available both online and offline.

Are you looking for more information on how to use our course material? Please visit the Parents & Teachers information page on our website via the below button.

pages.title: Partners
pages.content:
E-learning for kids is a non-profit organization providing free, fun, curriculum based quality primary education to all children world wide.

At the end of 2019 we’ve reached over 19 million children with our free course material. Our ambition is to reach 100 million children by 2025. Become our partner and help us reach our goal.

More information about becoming our partner can be found on the Partner-page of our website.

pages.title: About us
pages.content:
Math World is developed by e-learning for kids, a non-profit organization. Our vision is to be the source for childhood learning on the internet available from anywhere and without charge.

E-Learning for kids integrates gaming and learning to make our courseware more effective. That is why we offer free, best-in-class curriculum based learning for children ages 5-12 in Math & Science. Our courses are available both online & offline, and always for free.

At the end of 2019 we’ve reached over 19 million children with our free course material. Our ambition is to reach 100 million children by 2025.

More information about us? Please visit our website.

pages.title: Donate
pages.content:
Your donation makes a difference!

Your funding contribution will allow us to continue to develop new course material and translate our current e-learning courses to reach more children. This will support children, teachers, & schools all over the world.

Please support us in our goal to reach 100 million children by 2025. You can make a donation on our website.

languages.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
languages.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

languages.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Nuestro plan de estudios de los grados K a 6 se corresponde a las siguientes edades:
languages.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
Es muy importante que los niños empiecen en el nivel adecuado, se diviertan aprendiendo y trabajen a su propio ritmo. Por favor, ayuden a los niños a seleccionar un nivel que no sea demasiado fácil, pero tampoco demasiado difícil para ellos. Hay dos maneras de hacerlo.

  • Puede comprobar usted mismo los objetivos de aprendizaje para determinar el nivel correcto para su(s) niño(s).
  • O puede dejar que el niño tome varias lecciones para determinar su nivel. Por ejemplo, si el niño tiene 6 años, por favor déjelo tomar una lección en el grado K, una lección en el grado 1, y una lección en el grado 2 para determinar en qué nivel se encuentra.
